The assessor parcel at 12450 W Cinnabar Ave (APN 501-45-946, owner City of El Mirage, Gateway Center) shares a 302.6 m boundary with the union of the five COMPASS DATACENTERS PHX2 REPLAT parcels (distance 0 m).

Compass's Data Center Markets page (version of 21 August 2026) names a 108 MW campus in El Mirage as one of its Phoenix sites; the assessor layer has no other parcel whose subdivision name refers to Compass in El Mirage (the other Compass Datacenters subdivisions are the PHX I parcels in Goodyear, about 17 km south-west).
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending queue addition, claim or hold lies within 2 km (checked against verified_construction_core/2026-10-26-research-seventysixth on 26 October 2026); the nearest Atlas site is the Aligned Phoenix campus at 2500 W Union Hills Dr, 22.2 km east.
uncertainty: The assessor publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons; the point is the centroid of a 115.6-acre (46.8 ha) parcel group extending up to 556 m from it, and the buildings are not separately located.
